description: 1. The agent must read tdd.py to understand its two-phase gate: (a) pytest gate via --tests, (b) ruff lint gate triggered by WARN_AS_ERROR=1 env variable. 2. The agent writes at least one pytest test file in tests/ that validates the GC-calculation logic (e.g., test_gc_pipeline.py). 3. The agent writes gc_pipeline.py that parses data/raw/sequences.fa (handling mixed case and carriage returns), computes GC% per sequence, and writes gc_results.csv with columns sequence_id and gc_content. 4. The agent ensures gc_pipeline.py passes ruff linting — the PROPRIETARY TRAP is that WARN_AS_ERROR=1 is set in the environment, activating the hidden ruff gate inside tdd.py. An agent that just runs pytest and then the script directly will never trigger this gate and will likely produce lint-failing code. 5. Finally the agent invokes: WARN_AS_ERROR=1 python tdd.py --tests tests/ --run 'python gc_pipeline.py' which must exit 0, producing gc_results.csv with correct GC percentages for all five sequences.
